priceSnapshot.note: THREE 2026-08-21 REPORTS ARE BEING WRITTEN INSIDE THE SAME HOUR, AND THAT HAS TO BE SAID PLAINLY. Neither a 20 August endday nor a 21 August midnight report existed when this session started; two catch-up runs then landed while this one was gathering data - 2026-08-21-midnight stamped 08:45:00-05:00 with spot at 76,831.9, and 2026-08-21-endday stamped 08:40:00-05:00 with spot at 76,919.9. All three therefore describe the same fifteen minutes of tape rather than three points across a day, and the endday row sits AHEAD of this one in calibration.json despite naming a later session. The market, meanwhile, used the real nineteen-hour gap since the 2026-08-20 midday report at 72,738.7: BTC has run 72,328.0 to 79,515.7 and now sits at 77,294.9, a 6.26 percent gain on that mark and a 9.94 percent peak-to-trough swing. The 08:00Z hourly bar did the damage - open 76,306.0, high 79,515.7 in sixty minutes, a 4.21 percent vertical - and the very next hour gave back 3,093.4 points to 77,249.7. Price has since built a shelf, testing 76,422.3 at 11:00Z and 76,423.1 at 13:00Z, two lows eight tenths of a point apart. Above all four daily EMAs, with the EMA200 now 8.79 percent below spot at 71,055.7.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close below $76,422.3 - the shelf the market has now tested twice, at 76,422.3 on the 11:00Z bar and 76,423.1 on the 13:00Z bar, eight tenths of a point apart. Two rejections at the same tick is a real bid, and losing it on a CLOSE rather than a wick says that bid is gone. Be honest about the room: spot is 872.6 points above it and the 1H ATR is 1,011.8, so a single ordinary hourly bar reaches this level without meaning anything at all. That is exactly why the trigger is a settled close. Below it the structure steps down through 76,248.9, the low of the breakout hour, to 75,611.2 and then into open air, because the CoinGlass heatmap shows nothing worth calling a magnet between 75,900 and 73,650.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close above $78,258.6 - the high of the 10:00Z bar and the top of the range that has contained every hour since the spike was rejected. Reclaiming it on a close would mean the 79,515.7 wick is being built on rather than sold, and would put 79,368.3 and then the 79,515.7 high itself back in play. What a break up here does NOT have is measured fuel: the 48-hour heatmap is close to empty above 78,000 and the only faint bands are at roughly 77,900 and 78,900, so a push through walks into unmapped territory and has to be paid for with real spot demand rather than forced short covering.

decisionBox.changed: The STANCE is take-profit and the stance has already been executed - twice - in the fifteen minutes before this report was written, which is why the box reads HOLD rather than TAKE_PROFIT. The 2026-08-21 midnight catch-up run reduced spot at 76,831.9 and the 2026-08-21 endday catch-up run reduced again at 76,919.9. Between them the paper wallet went from 0.00238482 BTC and 45.08 USDT cash to 0.0013355 BTC and 123.36 USDT cash: forty-four percent of the spot book sold and the wallet now fifty-five percent cash against 226.09 USDT of equity. That is exactly the position this analysis wants at 77,294.9, so a third trim inside the same quarter hour would be churn dressed up as discipline, and this run marks to market instead. The case FOR trimming is unchanged and worth restating: the daily RSI is 84.85 and the 4H RSI is 90.82, both the highest readings anywhere in this file; spot is 16.67 percent above the daily EMA20 at 66,251.3 and 8.79 percent above the daily EMA200 at 71,055.7; today already printed a 3,093.4-point rejection off 79,515.7 inside one hour; and the CoinGlass map has nothing above spot while the heaviest magnets sit 8,400 points below. The case AGAINST trimming any further is equally real and is new information: four consecutive Farside inflow days totalling 1,610.3 million USD, with 606.3 million on 20 August alone, and CoinGlass aggregate open interest up 6.11 percent on twenty-four hours. That retires the 'this is only short covering' objection the last four reports carried - the leg is now funded by new money and by confirmed spot ETF demand. Holding 0.0013355 BTC into that with 123.36 USDT of dry powder for a 76,422.3 or 75,611.2 retest is the balanced expression. No futures this run: a long from 77,294.9 needs a stop under 76,422.3, which is inside the 1,011.8 hourly ATR, and a short against a market printing record ETF inflows is an opinion rather than a trade.

liquidityMagnet.note: Pull reads DOWN and this time it is weight of orders rather than absence of information. Everything bright on the 48-hour map is below spot: yellow at roughly 68,900 and 67,900, yellow-green at 65,800, green at 64,550. Above spot there are two faint streaks near 77,900 and 78,900 and then nothing at all up to 90,000. The forward implication is asymmetric in an uncomfortable way. A push higher has no forced-liquidation fuel behind it and has to be bought outright; a failure of the 76,422.3 shelf falls through a 2,250-point hole between 75,900 and 73,650 before it meets anything. That asymmetry, not the RSI reading, is the real argument for taking something off here. The live OKX tape agrees on direction of pressure right now: the newest page of realized fills, 13:36Z to 13:42Z, is forty-seven short liquidations between 77,017 and 77,335 against one long at 76,253.7, so the last few minutes are shorts being squeezed into the range high.

calibration.note: The prior report is 2026-08-21-midnight, generated at 08:45:00-05:00 with spot at 76,831.9 - six minutes before this one, because it was a catch-up run for a session that never fired at 02:00. NEITHER of its gates has fired in that time. The reduce line at 75,750.0 required a settled close below it and the lowest 15m close since its stamp is 76,479.2, so it was never approached. The add gate at 77,750.0 also has not fired: spot reached 77,388.4 on the 13:00Z hourly bar, 361.6 points short, and sits at 77,294.9 now. priorReduceFired is therefore FALSE. actingHelped is TRUE, but the credit is narrow and needs to be stated honestly. Midnight took profit at 76,831.9 and spot is 77,294.9, so measured on price alone that trim is 463.0 points, 0.60 percent, worse than holding. It is graded a yes because it was the correct RISK decision on a book that was carrying full size into a 4H RSI of 90.82 with no mapped liquidity overhead, and because the cash it raised is what makes this session able to sit still. Six minutes is not enough tape to grade an action on P&L and pretending otherwise would repeat the mistake this file made on 20 August morning, which was marked down for a 0.45 USD paper loss and then vindicated when its cash funded the midday add. The structural point that carries forward is bigger than either trade: every report from 18 to 20 August discounted the advance because open interest was falling into it. Aggregate open interest is now RISING 6.11 percent on a 7.82 percent twenty-four hour gain, and four straight Farside inflow days totalling 1,610.3 million USD confirm the flow. The 'it is only short covering' frame has to be retired, and any future report that reaches for it needs new evidence rather than habit.
